messages:
Alex: Heads-up — last night's GPU batch deploy failed in eu-west-1. Several GPU nodes came up NotReady. Saw logs referencing 'failed to decrypt secret' from sealed-secrets.
Priya: looking now. any rollback yet? :eyes: 
Ben: saw alert at 02:14 UTC, GPU autoscaler kept spinning but kubelet couldn't fetch cloud creds for node bootstrap.
Sam: paste from sealed-secrets-controller logs:
```
error: decrypting secret: kms: invalid key alias \"projects/.../locations/global/keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/alias-prod-eu\"
```
Maya: ah — terraform change two days ago flipped KMS env var name from CLOUD_KMS_KEY_ID -> KMS_KEY_ALIAS, so sealed secrets were re-encrypted with alias instead of key id in staging->prod pipeline.
Alex: so eu-west sealed-secrets controller can't resolve alias->key because alias is project-scoped and our KMS mapping is region-scoped. That would break decryption in regions without alias replication.
Priya: confirmed. GitOps commit 5f3c2a7 modified helmvalues: sealedSecrets.kmsKey: "{{ env.KMS_KEY_ALIAS }}" — instead of using managed key id. CI job that should validate KMS access didn't run for eu-west.
Ben: temp fix: rolled back to commit 4b9a8d1 which uses the key id. nodes started rejoining. :thumbsup: 
Sam: can we add a CI lint to catch "kms alias vs id" in helm values? also add integration test that decrypts a tiny sealed secret in each region.
Maya: opened infra-ticket #854 and added remediation steps: backport hotfix to dedicated clusters and update docs for KMS replication + alias usage.
infra-bot: Deployment rollback to 4b9a8d1 applied to cluster gpu-prod-eu-west (runbook ref: infra/rollbacks/2026-03-17) :white_check_mark: 
Priya: follow-ups — (1) add pre-deploy job to run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` per region, (2) add terraform validation to prevent env renames without migration plan, (3) create runbook for sealed-secret key rotation.
Ben: also let's add a Prometheus alert for "sealed-secrets decrypt errors" hitting >5m.
Alex: assigning owners: Priya on CI lint + tests, Ben on alerts, Maya on runbook + docs. ETA: EOD tomorrow for CI lint.
Sam: can someone add a note in the dedicated capacity runbook about "if GPU nodes fail during bootstrap check sealed-secrets KMS alias" — saved us 30m today.
Priya: adding now. thanks all. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
